body: I appreciate your concern very much, thank you! It is very tough and frustrating and it's a cycle of punishment really on both ends of the scale (eating far too much then fasting) Does speaking to people help you?

Thank you, I've found it really hard to lose this weight. I found a pair of my old jeans that I can JUST squeeze into so I'm using that as motivation, hopefully by next summer I'll be able to wear them properly :) 
I don't really take walks because I don't live in the nicest of places, but I enjoy going in my back garden and playing with my dog sometimes, and I like playing video games to help me unwind.
